designationHistory.indexText: Eastern Shore of Virginia National Wildlife Refuge, at the southern tip of the Delmarva Peninsula, was established in August 1984 on surplus federal property transferred for wildlife purposes.

authority.citation: Transfer of federal property under Public Law 80-537 (16 U.S.C. 667b)

designationHistory.note: FWS only; month and year only. The prior federal owner of the land was not confirmed in the passages read.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Eastern Shore of Virginia and Fisherman Island NWRs Comprehensive Conservation Plan, 2004 (ServCat 1416)
